system.description:
The military knighthood of Holfast: disciplined, loyal, and steeped in mounted warfare and formal doctrine.

  • Triple Strike: from 17th level, your Honour Attack triples the weapon's damage dice instead of doubling them (flat modifiers are not multiplied).
  • The Order's Name: Advantage on Persuasion and Intimidation checks when invoking the Order's name in Holfast or dealing with other formally recognised knightly orders.
